subject: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: GPU options, TPS & concurrency
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Hernandez <sofia@acmeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: GPU options, TPS & concurrency

Hi Sofia — thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our call and next steps so we can put together a sizing and cost estimate for Dedicated capacity: 

Summary of what I heard you say:
- Deployment mode: leaning toward Dedicated capacity (isolation + predictable throughput). Not pursuing Private VPC for initial rollout.
- Performance targets: target sustained throughput ~5-10 TPS for low-latency interactive inference; occasional bursts up to ~30 TPS for product launches.
- Concurrency: your product expects ~200 concurrent interactive users during normal operation, spike concurrency up to ~600 during promos (these translate to request concurrency depending on client-side batching).
- Token mix: average prompt ~300 tokens, average generated completion ~150 tokens. ~20% of requests are long-context (>= 1024 tokens). Embeddings usage is a separate stream at lower TPS.
- Model profile: planning to use an open Llama-family model similar to redwood-7b/13b equivalent; you flagged interest in better latency for the main call path.

Open questions for sizing (can you confirm?):
1) Is the 300/150 token split an average per request or the 95th percentile?
2) For bursts, are the 30 TPS bursts sustained for minutes or tens of minutes?
3) Any hard SLA for p95 latency (e.g., <200ms, <500ms)?

Initial next steps:
- If you can share a quick export of recent traffic (CSV) or the sample prompt set, we can run a perf test against a staging Dedicated cluster.
- Rafael + Marissa from our infra team will propose two sizing options (cost-optimized vs latency-optimized) with GPU suggestions (A100 vs H100) and expected headroom.
- I attached a recommended template (acme-dedicated-sizing.xlsx) — please fill the TPS/peak windows column and sample prompt rows if possible.

Thanks — will follow up once we have the traffic file. Proposed times for a technical sizing call: Wed 3/24 or Thu 3/25 at 10am PT.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: acme-dedicated-sizing.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Sofia Hernandez <sofia@acmeai.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: GPU options, TPS & concurrency

Thanks Aditya — great summary, that matches what we discussed. A few clarifications: 

- Token mix: the 300/150 split is an average — 95th percentile prompt length is closer to 800 tokens (about 15% of requests).
- Burst profile: the 30 TPS spike is typically sustained for ~10-20 minutes during marketing-driven surges; we saw ~25-40 minute peaks during last quarter's release.
- Latency SLA: we’re aiming for p95 < 400ms for the interactive path; p50 around 150-200ms would be ideal.
- Model: initially plan to use an offline-finetuned 13B Llama variant (we control model artifacts).

I attached the sizing spreadsheet with our weekly TPS by window and a sample of 200 prompts (anonymized). There’s also a separate embedding stream (approx 2 TPS) but longer texts. We’re not ready for Private VPC yet — Dedicated should cover our needs if sizing looks good.

Attaching: acme-dedicated-sizing.xlsx

Thanks — Sofia
Head of Product, Acme AI
sofia@acmeai.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Hernandez <sofia@acmeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 13:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: GPU options, TPS & concurrency

Perfect, thanks for the spreadsheet and the sample prompts — that’s very helpful. A few clarifying items and proposed options: 

Clarifying Qs (quick):
- The 95th prompt of ~800 tokens: is that concentrated in a particular API route or evenly distributed?
- For the embedding stream, is the 2 TPS steady or batch-y (i.e., do you batch many documents nightly)?

Proposed sizing options (ballpark) — Rafael/Marissa please chime in with more precise engineering numbers:
1) Latency-optimized (recommended for p95 < 400ms): 4x H100 (or equivalent) with 2x reserved machines for burst. This gives headroom for 30 TPS bursts and handles long-context requests with reduced queuing. Estimated baseline throughput ~12-15 sustained TPS for your 13B variant with 300-token prompts.
2) Cost-optimized: 6x A100 (higher concurrency but higher per-token latency); we’d rely more on batching and caching to meet cost targets. Baseline sustained TPS ~8-10 for interactive path; may require more autoscaling headroom for bursts.

Perf test: if you’re open, we can run a 2-hour perf sweep in our staging Dedicated cluster using your sample prompts to validate p50/p95 and token billing estimates. We’ll need a service account and an approved IP allowlist for the test. Prep doc attached: perf-test-instructions.pdf

Next steps: 
- Can you confirm where the 800-token 95th percentile is coming from and whether burst windows are consistent?
- Rafael, Marissa — can you run a quick calc from the attached spreadsheet and provide expected qps->GPU mapping and estimated monthly cost ranges?
- Sofia — which time on Wed/Thu works for a 45m technical sizing call?

Thanks — will schedule the call once we hear back.

Best,
Aditya

Attachment: perf-test-instructions.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: GPU options, TPS & concurrency

Looping you both in as discussed. Forwarding Sofia’s details and the filled spreadsheet. Quick internal notes: 

- Rafael: can you validate the two sizing options and provide expected token/sec and headroom numbers for H100 vs A100 for the 13B variant? We need expected baseline TPS, burst capacity, and a recommended autoscale min/max.
- Marissa: please estimate monthly cost ranges for both options (including reserved capacity + burst buffers). Also highlight any lead times for H100-backed Dedicated pools in our us-west region.

Target: get a short internal recommendation by EOD Tue so we can present to Sofia in the Wed/Thu call. I’ll take point on scheduling and perf-test coordination.

Thanks — Aditya

(Forwarded message attached)
